Джулія розповіла сестрі, що кілька ночей: Julia told her sister that for several nights she had heard a low, clear whistle at three o’clock.
За заповітом матері кожна дочка після шл: By their mother’s will each daughter got part of the money after marriage, and Roylott would be left almost without money.
Наприкінці Холмс бачить на голові Ройлот: At the end Holmes sees a yellow spotted “band” on Roylott’s head — it is a swamp adder, “the deadliest snake in India”.
Строката стрічка: The Adventure of the Speckled Band
Холмс помітив свіжі бризки болота на лів: Holmes noticed fresh spots of mud on her left sleeve — only a dog-cart splashes like that if you sit on the left of the driver.
Холмс прогнав змію палицею назад крізь о: Holmes drove the snake back through the hole with his stick, and the angry snake bit its owner.
Холмс смикнув шнур і з’ясував, що це бут: Holmes pulled the cord and found out that it was a fake: it hangs on a hook next to the ventilator.
Через «ремонт» стіни її кімнати пробили,: Because of the “repairs”, holes were made in the walls of her room, although, as Holmes noticed, no repairs were needed there.
